tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: ONE full-body single pose of the exact Koala adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the lightly anthropomorphic upright short-legged mascot and original arm-like forelimbs; do not revert to a natural quadruped. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 THINK: Curious pondering small head tilt, existing forelimb close to chin where this anatomy permits; otherwise a small head/bill down tilt with natural resting wing/fin. Species constraints: 全身の大きさをふくらませない。コアラの大きい鼻と丸耳、ウォンバットの幅広鼻、カバの大きい口元、白クマの淡い毛色をそれぞれ維持。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states. Critical alpha requirement: The entire outside region beyond the complete subject contour must be empty fully transparent, alpha zero. No cloud, white paper, fog, vignette, loose pigment, matte rectangle, ambient glow, shadow or colour bleed beyond its outline. Keep the subtle paper texture INSIDE the koala only. Use a small smooth rounded animal paw near the chin with two short crease marks, no human thumb/index finger.
